user.title: Kattio panel
user.description: Adds a page to the sidebar (and the Home Assistant apps) where you can talk to your assistant. You can change all of this later under Configure.

data_description.title: Shown in the sidebar and at the top of the page
data_description.pipeline: The assistant the page talks to: its conversation agent, speech-to-text and text-to-speech. Empty: the preferred pipeline.
data_description.users: Empty: everyone with a Home Assistant login
data_description.turn_server: Optional: a turn detection service (host or host:port, UDP, the same protocol as the Kattio boxes use). It hears when you are done speaking, also with a TV in the background, and when you interrupt the answer. Empty: Home Assistant's own end-of-speech detection.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The Kattio panel is already set up. Change it under Configure.
